name: Camping Seeblick Toni
beschreibung: The campsite Seeblick Toni is located in Kramsach directly on the shore of the Reintaler See. The location allows direct access to the water and a wide view of the surrounding mountain landscape. The site has level pitches for caravans and motorhomes as well as connections for fresh water and waste disposal. The proximity to the lake offers opportunities for swimming and for water sports. In the municipality of Kramsach there are shopping facilities and restaurants. The campsite is accommodation for guests who prefer a stay by the water.
